    This method: - Converts a single line of text into a Shape3D object - Splits the line into tokens (shape type and two numeric values) - Validates that the line contains at least three values - Parses the numeric values (height, radius, edge length, etc.) - Creates the correct shape type based on the first token

    This method: - Retrieves the comparison value for a given shape - Returns: → Volume if compareType = "v" → Surface area if compareType = "a" → Height for all other cases

    ShapeResults.printResults(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, String compareType, String compareLabel, String sortName, long elapsedMs)
    This method: - Prints summary information about the sorted shapes - Displays: → The first element in the sorted array → Every 1000th element (if applicable) → The last element in the sorted array - Shows the comparison value used for sorting (height, volume, or surface area) - Prints the total sorting time in milliseconds

    This method: - Sorts the given array of Shape3D objects - Uses the sort type code to determine which algorithm to run - Supports: → b = Bubble Sort → s = Selection Sort → i = Insertion Sort → m = Merge Sort → q = Quick Sort → z = AI Sort - Prints an error message if the sort type is unknown

    static void
    AISortUtility.aiSort(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Performs AI-assisted sorting on the array - Extracts numeric values based on the comparator type - Sends values to the Python script in JSON format - Receives a sorted index order and rearranges the array - Falls back to Merge Sort if the AI script fails
    static void
    SortUtility.aiSort(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Uses an external AI-based sorting algorithm - Delegates sorting to AISortUtility.aiSort()
    static void
    SortUtility.bubbleSort(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Sorts the array using Bubble Sort - Repeatedly compares adjacent elements - Swaps elements when the left value is smaller than the right value
    int
    HeightComparator.compare(Shape3D shape1, Shape3D shape2)
    This method: - Compares the height of two shapes - Returns a positive value if shape2 is taller than shape1 - Returns a negative value if shape1 is taller than shape2 - Returns zero if both shapes have equal height
    int
    NameComparator.compare(Shape3D shape1, Shape3D shape2)
    This method: - Compares the names of two shapes alphabetically - Ignores uppercase/lowercase differences - Returns a positive value if shape1's name comes after shape2's name - Returns a negative value if shape1's name comes before shape2's name - Returns zero if both names are identical
    int
    SurfaceAreaCompartor.compare(Shape3D shape1, Shape3D shape2)
    This method: - Compares the surface area of two shapes - Returns a positive value if shape2 has a larger surface area than shape1 - Returns a negative value if shape1 has a larger surface area than shape2 - Returns zero if both shapes have equal surface area
    int
    VolumeComparator.compare(Shape3D shape1, Shape3D shape2)
    This method: - Compares the volume of two shapes - Returns a positive value if shape2 has a larger volume than shape1 - Returns a negative value if shape1 has a larger volume than shape2 - Returns zero if both shapes have equal volume
    private static double[]
    AISortUtility.extractValues(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Extracts numeric values from each shape - Uses height, volume, or surface area depending on comparator type
    static void
    SortUtility.insertionSort(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Sorts the array using Insertion Sort - Builds a sorted section one element at a time - Shifts smaller values to the right to make space for larger ones
    private static void
    SortUtility.merge(Shape3D[] shapes, Shape3D[] left, Shape3D[] right, int leftCount, int rightCount, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Merges two sorted subarrays into one sorted array - Places larger values first according to the comparator
    static void
    SortUtility.mergeSort(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Sorts the array using Merge Sort - Recursively splits the array into halves - Merges the halves back together in sorted order
    private static int
    SortUtility.partition(Shape3D[] shapes, int i, int j, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Partitions the array around a pivot element - Moves all values greater than the pivot to the left side - Moves all smaller values to the right side
    static void
    SortUtility.quickSort(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Sorts the array using QuickSort - Recursively partitions the array around a pivot value - Places larger values to the left and smaller values to the right

    SortUtility.quickSortHelper(Shape3D[] shapes, int i, int j, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Performs the recursive QuickSort steps - Sorts the left and right partitions around the pivot

    SortUtility.selectionSort(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
    This method: - Sorts the array using Selection Sort - Repeatedly finds the largest remaining value - Places it at the front of the unsorted section
